candidates.title: LiteLLM v1.110.0-rc.3
candidates.summary: ## Verify Docker Image Signature All LiteLLM Docker images are signed with [cosign](https://docs.sigstore.dev/cosign/overview/). This release is signed with the key introduced in [commit `e82a3c6`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/commit/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065). **Verify using the pinned commit hash (recommended):** A commit hash is cryptographically immutable, so this is the strongest way to ensure you are using the published signing key: ```bash cosign verify \ --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \ ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.110.0-rc.3 ``` **Verify using the release tag (convenience):** Tags are pro
